description: This file declares functions for calculating CRC checksums, including CRC-8 and CRC-32 variants. It includes function prototypes for calculating CRCs from a message array and for incremental CRC-32 calculation. The file contains type definitions, include guards, and C/C++ compatibility macros.

methods.name: calc_crc
methods.description: Calculates an 8-bit CRC checksum for a message array of specified length.

methods.name: crc32
methods.description: Calculates a 32-bit CRC checksum for a buffer of given size.

methods.name: crc32inc
methods.description: Incrementally updates a CRC-32 checksum with additional data from a buffer.
